title: The Only Trait for Success in the AI Era—How to Build It | Carnegie Mellon University Po-Shen Loh
description:
Po-Shen Loh reveals why modern education may be failing us—and what it will take for humanity to thrive in the AI era.

From AI solving Olympiad-level problems to students outsourcing their thinking to ChatGPT, he warns that our mental fitness is at risk. But Loh also offers a path forward: cultivating thoughtfulness, empathy, and a network of kind, clever people who can tackle the challenges of the future.

How do we prepare the next generation in a world where AI can outcreate us? Loh shares a compelling vision for education that builds not just skills, but the mindset and community needed to sustain civilization itself.

- Visit Po-shen Loh's website: https://poshenloh.com/

Key Insights:
📌 Why using AI to replace thinking undermines mental fitness
📌 The uniquely human trait that will matter most in the AI era
📌 How empathy and “simulating the world” are survival skills
📌 Why building networks of kind, capable people is essential for the future
📌 A scalable model for teaching critical thinking and charisma to the next generation
